title: Deep-learning-based Prediction of Late Age-Related Macular Degeneration Progression.
summary: A deep CNN combining fundus images with genotype data predicted late AMD progression in 1,351 AREDS participants; AUC was 0.85 versus 0.81 for images alone.
ai_technology: The modified deep CNN used fundus images with genotype features to estimate late-AMD progression.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: A deep CNN combining fundus images with genotype data predicted late AMD progression in 1,351 AREDS participants; AUC was 0.85 versus 0.81 for images alone.
evidence.unknown: The model was evaluated in 1,351 AREDS participants; the reported AUC comparison does not establish benefit from clinical use.
